主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced a quarterly cash dividend of 17 cents per share on February 28, 2019. The dividend, payable on March 29, 2019, to shareholders of record as of March 15, 2019, represents an increase from the previous quarter's 16 cents per share. The decision to raise the dividend was based on the company's strong financials and its ability to maintain profitability despite market conditions. The company's financial statements and exhibits are available on the SEC website and the company's website, www.kybank.com. The company also noted that forward-looking statements in the report are subject to risks and uncertainties, including changes in economic conditions, regulatory enforcement, and interest rates, which could affect future results. The company's annual report on Form 10-K and other filings are available on the SEC website and the company's website.
